Who's who in Tent D?

Today we will:

  1. find out where nicknames come from
  2. be detectives: why is he called that?
  3. draw a Tent D gallery in our notebooks
  4. invent our own camp nickname
  5. play Guess who?

SAY ITno writingWarm-up: where do nicknames come from?

Nicknames usually come from...

Looks"Curly": curly hair
Does"Speedy": always first
Real name"Jojo": from Joanna
Something that happened"Splash": fell in the pool
A joke (the opposite)"Tiny": the tallest boy

Your turn: which kind is each one?

"Snooze": always asleep in classDOES
"Ginger": red hairLOOKS
"Kaz": real name KazimierzREAL NAME
"Bumper": crashed on the school tripHAPPENED
"Sweet Feet": shoes that stinkA JOKE
"Mom": a man with a big beardA JOKE
Show answersThe last two are from Holes!
SAY ITtalk with a partner, no writing yetNickname detectives

Why is he called that? What do we know so far?

X-Ray Rex

Glasses so dirty Stanley wonders how he can see. Says "I can see inside you, Mom." Has his own shortest shovel.

Say "Rex" in Pig Latin: move the R to the end and add "ay": Ex-R-ay. The book confirms it in chapter 11!

Armpit Theodore

Throws Stanley to the ground for calling him Theodore. Spits on the tent floor. Snores.

No reason yet. Which kind of nickname could it be: looks, does, real name, happened, or a joke?

Squid Alan

Tells Mr Pendanski, "My name's not Alan. It's Squid." Asks if the shoes were from "a store" or "someone's feet".

No reason yet: invent a theory!

Magnet Jose

We know almost nothing yet!

What do magnets do to things near them? Watch Magnet closely later in the book.

Zigzag Ricky

We know almost nothing yet!

What does a zigzag line look like? What kind of person might move or think like that?

Zero ???

Nobody knows if "Zero" is his real name. Says nothing. Digs faster than anyone. Mr Pendanski says there is "nothing inside his head".

Is Mr Pendanski's reason fair? What does Zero do well?
Barf Bag (Lewis) is gone: he's in hospital and won't come back. Stanley gets his cot.
WATCHno writing yetWhat a gallery card looks like

My example: Mr Sir (not in Tent D!)

Stick figures are fine! 1 minute max.

Real name: ??? (probably not "Mr Sir"!)

Called: Mr Sir

1 detail: He makes Stanley call him "Mr Sir" every time he speaks.

Signature: a sack of sunflower seeds

My theory: I think he is called Mr Sir because he wants everyone to treat him like the boss.

Draw 8 boxes on a double page. One boy per box.

In each box:

  1. quick drawing (1 minute)
  2. real name + nickname
  3. 1 detail from the book
  4. my theory: "called ___ because ___"

Detail bank

dirty glassesshortest shovel"I can see inside you"spitssnoresthrew Stanley down"My name's not Alan"digs fastestsays nothingpalindrome nameBarf Bag's old cot
Halfway check at 9 minutes: you should have 4 boxes done. Extension (early finishers): add Mr Pendanski or Barf Bag in the spare box.
WRITEin your notebook, under the galleryIf you were in Tent D...

Invent your own camp nickname

At Camp Green Lake they would call me ___
because I ___ .
It is a ___ kind of nickname (looks / does / real name / happened / joke).

Example: At Camp Green Lake they would call me "Bookworm" because I always have a novel in my bag. It is a "does" kind of nickname.

Rules

  • Kind, not mean.
  • Only for yourself, not a classmate.
  • Nothing about anyone's body.

Then draw your camp badge: your nickname in big letters, with a small picture.

Extension (early finishers): write 2 sentences: would you prefer to be called by your nickname or your real name at Camp Green Lake? Why?

Success checklist

  • 8 boxes, one boy in each
  • Real name + nickname in each box
  • 1 detail from the book in each box
  • A theory with "because"
  • My own nickname + badge
